About

About the Webmaster

19/they/USA

My main interests are vocal synthesis, video games, and linguistics. Some of my sub-interests include coding (of course), cute things, and public transportation. In my free time, I like to draw, write, play games, listen to music, scroll social media, and use my computer.

Yes, I'm autistic. How did you know? I have ADHD too.

My native language is English. I can speak some Japanese, and bits and pieces of Chinese. I can read Hangeul, but I don't really know Korean. In the future, I want to be a linguistics major and translator of Japanese.

About the Website

I made this website on August 18, 2020 for reasons that are beyond me. I left it alone for six years, and then picked it back up in February of 2026 because I was bored and wanted a space away from social media. I abandoned it for a few more months and came back again in July 2026, so I could host my UTAU here.

While I didn't use generative AI to create this website (code, writing, art done by me or sourced from humans), genAI is forced on me daily by virtue of being on the internet. Despite trying my best to avoid it. We're all going to hell.

My website is "licensed" under CC0.

Accessibility

See: /posts/accessibility.html

Sinigang?

It's a popular Filipino soup. It's pretty sour. A lot of people tend to name themselves after food, so I wanted to try that too.

Who's the character to the left of me (on desktop?)

It's Kasane Teto SV! More specifically, it's their official standing portrait, illustrated by Sakauchi Waka.

You're an artist, right? Hey, where's your art!? WHERE IS IT!

I AM A FUCKING ARTIST!! It's just...that... like, I have a lot of drawings, and a lot of them are only okay so like IDK if I would wanna reupload all of them to my website... but I have been considering dumping all my art into a .zip file, if you don't like social media but still like my art.

I essentially use Tumblr as an art archive, but I know this is kinda bad practice; Tumblr barely lets you look at anything without an account and my account's only available to logged-in Tumblr users... I'm sorry...

Why don't you have a site profile?

From Mevdik:

In my extremely subjective opinion which you should treat as such, this whole profile thing is a bad idea. It's presence drags social media attitudes to a website of websites that is supposed to be an escape from the social media hellscape of today. At least that is how a lot of people like to present this platform.

I'm inclined to agree with her. In the future, I intend to create an RSS feed for this website for updates instead.
